_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE, arm 16 — THE SPEC'S DECISIVE ARM: the arm-14 posture (single-layer
canonical + carry_rx_code_bias FALSE) with CARD LV-1 armed.  Two knobs vs arm 12,
one vs arm 14: network.iono_seed_field_frame.
WHAT THE SPEC ASKED THIS ARM TO DECIDE (docs/SPEC_level_information_budget.md S3):
"if the mechanism model is right, the -9 TECU/ep collapse largely DISAPPEARS without
the carry crutch (predict: a00 stays > 10 through 20 ep, in-band).  If it still
collapses, the model is wrong -- STOP, instrument the level-direction information
decomposition before touching anything else."
PREDICTION, STATED BEFORE THE RUN: IT STILL COLLAPSES.  a00 free-falls ~-9 TECU/ep to
-37..-39 and every emission is withheld, reproducing arm 14 to within trace noise.
WHY, ANALYTICALLY, AHEAD OF THE RUN.  The seed-frame stiffness the model rests on
does not exist on this path: the per-station state vector is a frozen LINEARIZATION
POINT, the per-epoch absolute solve carries NO Kalman prior on local nuisances, and
every row on a GPS iono column carries x_lin with its own A_r coefficient -- so a seed
shift leaves the reduced RHS EXACTLY invariant (2026-08-01 invariance theorem, memory
project_network_xlin_invariance).  With the carry OFF, even LV-1's one genuine
actuator on the carry-ON leg (the rx-CB inject gate, a PREFIT screen on
|value_abs - x_lin(cb)|) is absent, so nothing but the trace-only prefit census can
move at all.
SO THIS ARM IS RUN AS A FALSIFICATION, NOT AS A HOPE.  Reading it:
- Collapse reproduced (expected): the spec's per-LOS-ensemble gradient model is dead
and the STOP clause is answered -- the level-direction decomposition is the next
card, and LV-2 (which changes prior-row RHS, not a linearization frame) is the
actuator that remains.
- Collapse GONE (unexpected): the invariance theorem has an exception on this
lineage.  That is a bigger result than the card; find the non-invariant row before
touching any other knob (candidates: a prefit-gated row set, the GLONASS-style
y=0 anchors, anything thresholding a prefit residual).
